question.prompt: Lines \(a\) and \(b\) are cut by line \(c\). Angles \(\angle 1\) and \(\angle 2\) are alternate interior angles, with \(\angle 1=3x+10^\circ\) and \(\angle 2=5x-30^\circ\). If \(a\parallel b\), find the value of \(x\).

solutions.explanation: When \(a\parallel b\), alternate interior angles are equal: \(3x+10=5x-30\). Solving gives \(x=20\) (both angles are then \(70^\circ\)).
solutions.title: Equal alternate interior angles
